name: send_message
title: Send message
description: Send a short message to a colleague or supplier (Slack handle like @daniel, or an email address). Goes through Ledgerline's notification queue.

ok.description: true when it worked; false comes with error and next_step

policy.on_lost_write_reply: never resent blindly: look the document up (by its key or by what changed) and return it
policy.on_busy_before_write: ok=false with next_step; nothing was saved, so the same call is safe to repeat

release_notes.1.1: 3 Nov 2026 (Lecture 4 production-grade pass): a lost ntf_send reply is looked up in the queue instead of coming back as TIMEOUT, so a retry no longer queues the message twice.
